verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no feature for building a team workspace from docs and repos. AGENTS.md project rules only become shared if a team commits them to git, which is a user-side arrangement. `/share` shares a single session URL, which is an adjacent feature rather than a common source of truth. Neither earns credit toward a shared team workspace built from docs and repos.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can create a shared workspace from my docs and repos as a common source of truth for the team
